*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""MolmoSpaces cabinet-close episode controller (eai-standard/2.2).
+
+The door is approached from its outside face, the wrist is rolled so the
+gripper fingers run along the door edge, and the panel is pushed inward in
+short increments. This file records the controller used for the episode.
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+def run():
+    r = Robot()
+    hz = float(r.spec()["control_hz"])
+    obs = r.get_obs()
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    q = now[:7]
+    open_pose = now[25:29].tolist()
+
+    def move_tcp(pos, quat, n=16, grip=0, note="cabinet approach"):
+        nonlocal q
+        sol = r.ik({"gripper": [*pos, *quat]}, seed=q)
+        if not sol.get("ok"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed at {pos}: {sol.get('error')}")
+        target = np.asarray(sol["q"], dtype=float)
+        rows = np.column_stack((np.linspace(q, target, n), np.full(n, grip)))
+        result = r.submit(
+            "joint_position", rows, dt=1.0 / hz,
+            cameras=["randomized_zed2_analogue_1", "droid_shoulder_light_randomization"],
+            video_fps=3, note=note,
+        )
+        q = np.asarray(result.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
+        return result
+
+    # Clear the approach area, then move beside the panel while keeping the
+    # gripper open.
+    move_tcp([1.46, 1.32, 2.25], open_pose, n=22, note="lower outside approach")
+    move_tcp([1.46, 1.23, 2.34], open_pose, n=20, note="approach cabinet edge")
+    move_tcp([1.56, 1.34, 2.35], open_pose, n=20, note="track along door outside")
+
+    # Downward fingers with the closing axis along the panel edge.
+    edge_grasp = [0.0, 0.936, 0.353, 0.0]
+    move_tcp([1.56, 1.34, 2.35], edge_grasp, n=24, note="align fingers with door edge")
+
+    # Push inward along the measured closing direction in small increments.
+    move_tcp([1.604, 1.336, 2.35], edge_grasp, n=10, grip=255,
+             note="contact cabinet panel")
+    p = np.asarray([1.604, 1.336, 2.35], dtype=float)
+    close_dir = np.asarray([0.66, -0.75, 0.0], dtype=float)
+    close_dir /= np.linalg.norm(close_dir)
+    for _ in range(12):
+        p = p + 0.005 * close_dir
+        move_tcp(p.tolist(), edge_grasp, n=3, grip=255,
+                 note="incremental cabinet closing push")
+
+    r.submit("done", [])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run()
*** End Patch";
